content.short: Credix provides access to portals for credit investing.
content.description: Credix is a next-generation credit ecosystem built to connect institutional borrowers with liquidity while opening attractive, risk-adjusted investment opportunities for institutional investors, credit funds, and accredited investors. The platform's technology enables the tokenization and securitization of real-world assets, transforming them into programmable assets and automating capital markets workflows. By digitizing private credit, Credix aims to modernize a substantial market and unlock new avenues for efficient financing and investment.
content.meta: Credix is a credit ecosystem enabling institutional borrowers to access liquidity. Discover Credix and other Real World Asset Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
